title: Pricing data Scientist
description:
Pricing Data Scientist

Remote (UK) | £80,000 - £100,000

This is an opportunity to join a specialist insurer undergoing a significant transformation across pricing, data, and technology. You'll play a key role in building new pricing capabilities, working on high-impact modelling projects, and helping shape the future direction of a growing function.

The Company

This established insurance business operates within the personal lines market and is investing heavily in its pricing and data capabilities. With ambitious growth plans and a strong focus on innovation, they are modernising their approach to pricing, analytics, and technology. The team is relatively small, offering excellent exposure to senior stakeholders and the opportunity to make a visible impact.

The Role

  • Develop and enhance risk pricing models using statistical and machine learning techniques
  • Build, validate, and monitor predictive models in Python
  • Deliver customer segmentation, conversion modelling, and pricing analytics projects
  • Support the development of a proprietary pricing and rating platform
  • Work closely with technical, commercial, and underwriting stakeholders to influence pricing decisions

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience in risk pricing within personal lines insurance
  • Experience in motor insurance is highly desirable, although home, pet, travel, or similar insurance backgrounds will also be considered
  • Proven experience building predictive models in Python
  • Strong understanding of GLMs, with exposure to GBMs or other machine learning techniques being advantageous
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to communicate findings to a range of stakeholders
  • Degree in a quantitative discipline such as Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Physics, Engineering, or Computer Science

How to Apply

To learn more about this Pricing Data Scientist / Principal Pricing Analyst opportunity, please apply with your CV for a confidential discussion.
